name: Server Herald
description: For dedicated servers and games you host: a message of the day for each player who joins, join, leave and death lines in the chat, announcements in turn from a file, a restart countdown (herald.restart, also from emf\commands.txt), a chat log per day, playtime per player, /players /playtime /motd for everyone, and an opt-in Discord webhook. Off until you switch it on: it changes what players see. Players need nothing.

settings.label: Message of the day
settings.help: Sent to each player who joins; {name} and {online} are filled in. Empty = none.

settings.label: An announcement every (minutes)
settings.help: The lines of emf\config\herald\announcements.txt in turn, while someone is online. 0 = off.

settings.label: Save when a restart countdown ends
settings.help: herald.restart counts down; at 0 the world is saved. Stopping the server stays outside EMF.

settings.label: Chat log
settings.help: Players' lines, joins and leaves in emf\logs\chat-YYYY-MM-DD.log.

settings.label: Count playtime
settings.help: Per player and world; /playtime shows yours.

settings.label: Discord webhook
settings.help: Posts to the URL in emf\config\herald\webhook.txt (never shown or logged). Off by default.

settings.label: Allow other https hosts
settings.help: Off: only discord.com and discordapp.com webhooks.
